findings.detail: B01 counts amortized-cost and fair-value numeric leaves together, producing 217 fair-value leaves out of 434 total leaves even though the investment schedule has a fair value column and fair-value total.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate completeness check. Raw source rows show the SOI has both Amortized Cost and Fair Value columns on investment rows; table 8 row 4, for example, has amortized cost 297,033 and fair value 298,988. Source totals confirm current-period investments at fair value of 7,356,032 and comparative-period investments at fair value of 7,244,282. The 217/434 metric therefore reflects a mixed leaf denominator containing both cost leaves and fair-value leaves, not missing fair values in the source.
